ev.q: To evaluate training effectiveness, data obtained through online surveys administered during June–September 2018 were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression.
This report presents evaluation data collected following implementation of training content.
Data obtained through online surveys sent to 850 human service organizations and 1,000 faith-based organizations during June–September 2018

equity.level_reason: Units are organizations; no social-position dimension of persons is measured or compared. Diverse communities are mentioned only in a closing sentence.

level_alternative.reason: Religious affiliation enters the models as a covariate, though it describes organizations rather than persons.

notes: Unit of analysis is the organization; outcomes are program/preparedness indicators, not health conditions, so conditions is empty. Separate models were fitted for each sector and each indicator. Design inferred as evaluation from the article's own wording; data are a single post-training survey.
